research_mode: official ONS and Home Office sources only; current methodology editions, survey and administrative compilation, contractor and ONS quality assurance, statistical designation and release assets; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Current crime QMI revision edition
verified_claims: the Crime in England and Wales QMI was last revised on 2 April 2026
the document describes strengths limitations and methods
QMI edition must be retained with derived methodology rules
limitations: revision date is not a data observation date
specific measures can use additional technical reports

sources.name: Crime-output compilation and frequency
verified_claims: Crime in England and Wales combines survey and administrative data
the statistical bulletin is produced quarterly
the two principal source types have different strengths and limitations
limitations: quarterly publication does not make every component quarterly
survey and administrative values must not be pooled without source metadata

sources.name: Police-data supply chain to ONS
verified_claims: police recorded crime is collated from 43 territorial forces plus British Transport Police
forces supply data to the Home Office monthly
aggregated data are then supplied to ONS for final preparation and publication
limitations: the aggregation chain is not direct parcel evidence
different stages can apply separate validation and revision processes

sources.name: Survey-contractor quality management
verified_claims: Verian is the CSEW survey contractor
ONS states that Verian has formally accredited quality-management systems
the systems are supported by research protocols from scripting through interviewing coding and data checking
limitations: contractor accreditation does not remove sampling or nonresponse uncertainty
specific annual fieldwork reports remain relevant

sources.name: ONS final-preparation quality assurance
verified_claims: ONS applies its own quality-management systems
the systems further quality assure data received from the contractor and administrative chain
quality assurance continues through final preparation and publication
limitations: publication QA is not equivalent to exact local validation
quality controls do not make estimates error-free

sources.name: Current crime-methodology hub edition
verified_claims: the ONS crime and justice methodology hub was last revised on 9 June 2026
the hub links user guides methodological notes and questionnaires
method selection should use the current linked edition
limitations: a hub page is an index rather than a single method specification
linked documents can have different revision dates

sources.name: Current crime user-guide edition
verified_claims: the March 2025 user guide was last revised on 5 June 2026
the guide covers CSEW police recorded crime comparisons classifications and statistical conventions
the revision date is required for reproducible interpretation
limitations: the title year and revision year are different metadata fields
later bulletins can add release-specific caveats

sources.name: Police-recorded-crime statistical designation
verified_claims: ONS labels police recorded crime as official statistics
police recorded crime data are not designated as accredited official statistics
designation must be stated separately from CSEW designation
limitations: non-accredited does not mean unusable
fitness depends on offence type recording quality and intended use

sources.name: CSEW statistical designation
verified_claims: ONS labels CSEW estimates as accredited official statistics
the estimates were independently reviewed by the Office for Statistics Regulation
the designation reflects trustworthiness quality and value standards
limitations: accreditation does not remove sampling uncertainty
designation applies to specified outputs and methods

sources.name: Current outcome-release asset bundle
verified_claims: the 2025 to 2026 release provides an HTML statistical release
it includes an ODS data-table file and a technical annex
the publication also includes a user-engagement exercise
limitations: different assets serve different analytical purposes
ODS tables and narrative must be edition-matched
